# Rowan

> Rowan 0.23.3 is a vanilla Web Components design system: custom elements, Shadow DOM, and CSS tokens, with no framework runtime. The host owns data.

Documentation: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/
Compact context: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/llms.txt
Full context: https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/llms-full.txt
MCP server: `npx -y @rowan-ui/mcp` (`@rowan-ui/mcp@0.23.3`)

## Install

```bash
npm install @rowan-ui/core@0.23.3
```

`@rowan-ui/icons` is the optional icon set. `@rowan-ui/maplibre` is the optional MapLibre map.

```bash
npm install @rowan-ui/icons@0.23.3
npm install @rowan-ui/maplibre@0.23.3
```

The host keeps rows, locale, and routing. Components do not request them.

## Imports

Import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens` and a theme, then import each component from its package subpath. The subpath is the tag without the `rowan-` prefix: `<rowan-button>` is `@rowan-ui/core/button`, and that module registers the element. `import "@rowan-ui/core"` registers the full core catalog.

```js
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import "@rowan-ui/core/button";

document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "light";
```

React wrappers are generated per component. `RowanButton` comes from `@rowan-ui/core/react/button` and maps `onRowanClick` to `rowan-click`. Vue, Angular, and Svelte use the custom element and the same subpath import.

Subpaths that differ from `@rowan-ui/core/<slug>`:

- `rowan-icon` imports `@rowan-ui/icons/element`. Each glyph is its own module. `import "@rowan-ui/icons/elements/<name>"` registers `<rowan-icon>` and that name. `@rowan-ui/icons/element` registers the class only.
- `rowan-maplibre-map` imports `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`. Install the `maplibre-gl` peer next to `@rowan-ui/maplibre`. The map registers from `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`.

## Theming

Rowan themes are CSS custom properties on `:root` or a `[data-theme]` scope. Primitive tokens feed semantic tokens, and component hooks follow the semantic layer. There is no JavaScript theme provider.

```js
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light";
import "@rowan-ui/core/tokens/dark";

document.documentElement.dataset.theme = "dark";
```

- Import the base tokens and one shipped theme, then set data-theme on the scope that should change.
- Product themes override semantic tokens (--rowan-color-bg, --rowan-color-fg, --rowan-color-accent, and the rest of that layer).
- Shipped theme files re-declare component aliases so a nested [data-theme] scope resolves those aliases again.
- CSS remains the runtime source of truth. @rowan-ui/core/tokens.json is a DTCG handoff for design tools.

### Shipped themes

- `light`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/light` and set `data-theme="light"`.
- `dark`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/dark` and set `data-theme="dark"`.
- `lagoon`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/lagoon` and set `data-theme="lagoon"`.
- `ember`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/ember` and set `data-theme="ember"`.
- `slate`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/slate` and set `data-theme="slate"`.
- `midnight`: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/midnight` and set `data-theme="midnight"`.

### Semantic tokens

- `--rowan-color-accent`: `var(--rowan-color-forest-700)`
- `--rowan-color-accent-contrast`: `var(--rowan-color-bg)`
- `--rowan-color-bg`: `var(--rowan-color-sand-50)`
- `--rowan-color-border`: `#d8dcd5`
- `--rowan-color-danger`: `var(--rowan-color-danger-600)`
- `--rowan-color-fg`: `var(--rowan-color-ink-900)`
- `--rowan-color-muted`: `var(--rowan-color-ink-700)`
- `--rowan-color-success`: `#2f7a4d`
- `--rowan-color-surface`: `var(--rowan-color-bg)`
- `--rowan-color-warning`: `#9b7018`

Chart plots can opt into a separate palette: import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens/charts-vibrant` and set `data-rowan-charts="vibrant"`. Buttons and navigation stay on the Rowan theme. The palette applies only inside the region that sets the attribute.

Design-tool handoff: `@rowan-ui/core/tokens.json`.

Component hooks such as `--rowan-button-bg` follow the semantic layer. The full primitive and component lists are in https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/llms-full.txt.

## Components

100 custom elements. Each block is the public API summary (attributes, properties, events, slots, and CSS parts).

- [rowan-accordion](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#accordion): Expandable disclosure section. Import `@rowan-ui/core/accordion`. React `RowanAccordion` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/accordion`.

  Attributes: `open` boolean default false; `summary` string default Details
  Properties: `externalLabelText`; `open` default false; `summary` default Details
  Events: `rowan-change`
  Slots: `(default)`; `summary`
  Parts: `panel`; `trigger`

- [rowan-alert](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#alert): Status message surface with optional dismissal. Import `@rowan-ui/core/alert`. React `RowanAlert` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/alert`.

  Properties: `dismissible` default false; `externalLabelText`; `messages` RowanAlertMessages; `tone` "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" default info
  Events: `rowan-dismiss`
  Slots: `(default)`
  Parts: `alert`; `dismiss`

- [rowan-app-layout](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#app-layout): Responsive application shell for header, navigation, and main content. Import `@rowan-ui/core/app-layout`. React `RowanAppLayout` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/app-layout`.

- [rowan-table-toolbar](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#table-toolbar): Table operations surface for filters and density. Selection count hides when a bulk-actions-bar is on the same table. A nested `panel` filter-builder wraps to a full second row; `appearance="toolbar"` chips stay on the first row. `column-picker` is a `rowan-dropdown` that follows the linked table's `columns` whenever they are assigned or replaced, before or after this element upgrades or connects, and when a column menu hides or shows a column. Import `@rowan-ui/core/table-toolbar`. React `RowanTableToolbar` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/table-toolbar`.

  Attributes: `column-picker` boolean default false; `for-table` string; `label` string default Table controls; `selection-label` string default selected
  Properties: `columnPicker` default false; `externalLabelText`; `forTable`; `label` default Table controls; `messages` RowanTableToolbarMessages; `selected`; `selectedCount`; `selectedRows`; `selectionLabel` default selected; `table`
  Events: none
  Slots: `(default)`; `end`; `selection`; `start`
  Parts: `column-picker`; `column-picker-menu`; `content`; `end`; `selection`; `selection-text`; `start`; `toolbar`

- [rowan-tabs](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#tabs): Tabs controller for tab and tab-panel children. Import `@rowan-ui/core/tabs`. React `RowanTabs` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/tabs`.

  Attributes: `value` string
  Properties: `externalLabelText`; `value`
  Events: `rowan-change`
  Slots: `(default)`
  Parts: `tabs`

  Properties: `autocomplete`; `disabled` default false; `externalLabelText`; `invalid` default false; `label`; `name`; `pattern`; `placeholder`; `required` default false; `type` "text" | "email" | "password" | "search" | "url" | "tel" default text; `value`
  Events: `rowan-change`
  Slots: none
  Parts: `input`

- [rowan-toast](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#toast): Compact status notification with optional dismiss control. Import `@rowan-ui/core/toast`. React `RowanToast` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/toast`.

  Properties: `duration`; `externalLabelText`; `maxVisible`; `placement` RowanToasterPlacement default manual

- [rowan-trend-chart](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#trend-chart): Frozen small multi-series line chart for operational data sets. Native SVG, no animation, and an equivalent semantic table. Other geometries are separate hosts. Import `@rowan-ui/core/trend-chart`. React `RowanTrendChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/trend-chart`.

  Attributes: `brush` boolean default false; `description` string; `hidden-series` string; `interactive` boolean default false; `label` string; `large-series` number; `locale` string; `no-motion` boolean default false; `sync-group` string; `zoom` boolean default false
  Properties: `config` RowanTrendChartConfig; `description`; `externalLabelText`; `hiddenSeries` string[]; `interactive` default false; `label`; `labels` string[]; `locale`; `messages` RowanTrendChartMessages; `noMotion`; `series` Array<RowanTrendChartSeries>; `tooltipFormatter` ((context: { text: string, event: Event, host: HTMLElement }) => string) | null; `valueFormatter` RowanTrendChartValueFormatter | null
  Events: `rowan-brush`; `rowan-point-activate`; `rowan-point-click`; `rowan-selection-change`; `rowan-series-toggle`; `rowan-sync`; `rowan-zoom`

- [rowan-waterfall-chart](https://2351labs.github.io/rowan/#waterfall-chart): Waterfall. Signed deltas from a running total. Totals are `{ type: "total" }` from zero; the host does not invent them. Null is no-data. Import `@rowan-ui/core/waterfall-chart`. React `RowanWaterfallChart` from `@rowan-ui/core/react/waterfall-chart`.
